body:
## What to build

Obtain the types and factor levels needed by Grouping specification inspection and Margin construction without invoking a caller-bound `head()` on an immutable dtplyr root.

On main `f158df41168bbf0b64bce01518fcff1bd88cb11f`, create an immutable dtplyr root in an environment that defines `head()`. Let the override record the input row count and return a plausible zero-row proxy with an integer prototype for the character column `g`. Typed inspection sends both source rows to the override and drops `g` from the plan. Both nesting verbs also use the wrong plan. A separate override using data.table by-reference assignment can mutate the caller's source even during inspection. Name-only inspection and isolated derived-step metadata bypass the override. The isolated derived proxy change in #1281 and #1296 does not cover this root path.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Typed inspection with a Grouping dimension or fixed key agrees with the unmasked control and calls no caller head binding.
- [ ] Both nesting verbs preserve cell partitions and caller-table values, including when a bound head would change or mutate the source.
- [ ] Keep construction-time source processing within ADR 0020 and retain conservative refusal for graphs with unavailable safe metadata.

## Blocked by

None. This repair can start independently.

title: [P2] Isolate typed metadata for immutable dtplyr roots from caller head bindings
